name: Gotenberg
tagline: Self-hostable HTTP API for PDF generation from HTML, Markdown, Office, and URLs
description: Gotenberg is a Docker-based API that converts HTML, Markdown, Office documents, and web pages into PDFs using Chromium and LibreOffice. Developers typically self-host it and call local or private HTTP endpoints for document conversion workflows.

auth.details: No built-in authentication by default; secure via reverse proxy, network isolation, or optional API key middleware if configured.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosted; no SaaS free tier or paid plans from the project

example.response_snippet: Binary PDF file (application/pdf) written to result.pdf

use_cases: convert HTML to PDF for invoices or reports
render a URL to PDF via Chromium
convert Office files (DOCX, XLSX) to PDF
merge or manipulate PDFs in an automated pipeline
